source_locators: EGNO calls (8.30) a natural transformation, printed page 214
formal_proof_route: Braiding swaps the chosen exact pairing, making X a right dual of X*.
Uniqueness of right duals gives the objectwise inverse.
Braiding naturality plus evaluation and coevaluation mate identities prove naturality.
NatIso.ofComponents derives inverse naturality from objectwise isomorphisms.

steps.source_locator: EGNO Proposition 8.9.3 and equation (8.31), printed pages 214-215
formal_proof_route: The composite mopFunctor followed by unmopFunctor has positive double braiding as its tensorator.
Mathlib monoidal composition supplies the tensorator coherence laws.
Transport across the Drinfeld natural isomorphism constructs a coherent monoidal structure on the right double-dual functor.
The transported tensorator makes the Drinfeld monoidal defect exactly positive monodromy.
The balancing law cancels that monodromy and proves theta_X followed by u_X is monoidal.
